note: São Tomé and Príncipe, read on 2026-10-30 on the site of the Serviço de Migração e Fronteiras (SMF): its e-Cidadão page, the online request for an authorisation to settle (autorização para fixação de residência), which lists the kinds of residence visa with the documents each asks under Law 5/2008 (the regime of foreigners' entry, stay and exit) and Decree-Law 11/2009, and the SMF's fee page. Four kinds are listed: subordinate professional activity (art. 35 of Law 5/2008, on a work contract and the opinion of the ministry concerned), independent professional activity (art. 36), family reunification (art. 39) and study, student exchange or professional traineeship; each is written as its own route, named as the page names it (the page spells the last 'Estudandes' and 'Estagio'; written here in its correct spelling). The page says a reply comes within 7 working days (art. 20(2) of Decree-Law 11/2009), written as each route's time; it is the time for the online request, which the page says is only for people in countries with no São Tomé diplomatic representation. Where the visa is otherwise applied for isn't said in words, so `apply` is left out. The SMF's fee page lists only passports' fees, so no fee is written; the page names no term, renewal, right to work beyond the work route's contract, permanent residence or naturalisation, and those are left out. The SMF's legislation page lists no texts today, so the law itself wasn't read.
